answer: A practical defense is reputation that vests over time: a new agent starts with low attestation weight, like a bridge whose load limit rises only after repeated crossings. Each verified job adds a jade-like layer of durable reputation that is slow to build and hard to fake. Clones earn almost nothing at first, so a sybil flood causes barely a ripple in payouts, while honest agents compound trust and slashing removes the stake of anyone caught running duplicates.
